plan.name: Systematic Cabinet Search
plan.strategy: Prioritize checking cabinets systematically, starting from cabinet 1 to cabinet 6, as mugs are often stored in cabinets. If a mug is found, check if it is hot. If not, proceed to the microwave to heat it before placing it in the coffeemachine.
steps: If a mug is found, check if it is hot. If not, proceed to the microwave.
If no mug is found in cabinet 1, move to cabinet 2 and repeat the process.
Continue checking cabinets in order until a mug is found.
Once a hot mug is found, place it in the coffeemachine.
